root_cause_label: response.sh writes incident reports to /app/reports/ instead of /app/, violating the benchmark artifact contract; secondary awk parser bug was later fixed but the path violation was never addressed.
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent writes incident reports to /app/reports/incident_<IP>_<timestamp>.txt instead of /app/incident_<IP>_<timestamp>.txt, violating the benchmark output-path contract, and never corrects this even after the report path is explicitly visible in test output at step 11.
t_err_evidence: Creating /app/intrusion_detector.sh ... counts total matches, ignores per-rule timeframe windowing and emits a non-spec alert/report schema.
t_commit_evidence: Once response.sh is written with the wrong output path at step 4, the agent never revisits or corrects this script through step 13; the path violation is baked in from the moment of creation.
trigger_explanation: The agent implemented response.sh without verifying where the benchmark expects incident report artifacts to be placed. It assumed /app/reports/ was the correct subdirectory without checking the specification, and subsequently never re-examined this assumption even when the path was visible in the step 11 output.
